C-SUPERSEDE-INTEGRATION-CLOSE-1-82073AAC.IntentSummary:
**This T2 plan converts the approved `C-SUPERSEDE-INTEGRATION-CLOSE-1-82073AAC` spec (B3 of the three-bundle split of the superseded `C-SUPERSEDE-MEMBERSHIP-2-C459A20C`) into seven sequential executable tasks plus the close.** The durable modules are exactly `M-CLI`, `M-GATES`, `M-CURSOR`, and `M-ARTIFACT-TYPES`; the verification anchors are their `V-M-*` entries. The deliverable is **test-only plus the close**: production source files are contextual integration anchors, **not forced edits**, so no `src/**` non-test file is in the write scope. `ObservedWriteScope` is exactly the spec's twelve literal non-lifecycle paths — the five forced tests/ratchet (`src/grace-supersede.test.ts`, `src/grace-cursor.test.ts`, `src/gates/core.test.ts`, `src/artifact/scope.test.ts`, `scripts/validate-record-retirement.test.ts`) and the seven RM-GOVERNED-PATH record XML files the shipped close writers touch (`decisions.xml`, `findings.xml`, `findings-retired.xml`, `rulings.xml`, `rulings-retired.xml`, `registry.xml`, `registry-retired.xml`) — with zero globs, no `decisions.md`, no `.ngrace/scratch/staged-findings.md`, and no bundle lifecycle path. `src/artifact/run-membership.test.ts` is an **unchanged read-only command input**, not an observed write.
**Execution is sequential; the machine DAG encodes it: T-001 → T-002 → T-003 → T-004 → T-005 → T-006 → T-007.** T-001 re-authors the close-time scope guard in `src/artifact/scope.test.ts` for this bundle's exact id `C-SUPERSEDE-INTEGRATION-CLOSE-1-82073AAC` and base `73044f83c3f4eaaaa5c5b7648a8a31c115337c39`, and fixes the committed B5 defect: the unconditional mint-time foreign-bundle assertion runs with no switch, so `bun run validate:ci` is red while this bundle exists; the re-authored guard must be **dormant** without its exact switch (collecting no evidence and not inspecting or failing on a future sibling bundle) and **activated** must recognize only this bundle's own lifecycle files while rejecting a foreign sibling, a forbidden ordinary path, a non-record file in the record directory, and a non-lifecycle file in its own bundle directory. No blanket sibling exemption is granted. T-002 through T-004 extend `src/grace-supersede.test.ts` (and `src/gates/core.test.ts`) with the integrated success path, the refusal matrix, post-fold failures, and the complete supersede matrix. T-005 pins the lock/allocator contract structurally and behaviorally in `src/grace-cursor.test.ts` (twelve concurrent real-CLI writers then an explicit-replacement supersede). T-006 integrates the membership/fold/discard matrix in `src/grace-cursor.test.ts`, re-driving the read-only `src/artifact/run-membership.test.ts`. T-007 re-authors the empty-`Pays` durable row ratchet in `scripts/validate-record-retirement.test.ts` and rehearses the shipped `--flush`/`--retire` transition on a disposable clone. T-007 satisfies no ordinary criterion: `AC-CLOSE-PAYER` is a close-bound criterion evaluated by the close, never a task `Satisfies` target.
**Mapping and close.** All eight ordinary criteria are mapped exactly once: `AC-SCOPE-GUARD-FINITE-FILES` and `AC-SCOPE-GUARD-GIT-STATUS` to T-001; `AC-SUCCESS-PATH-PRESERVED` to T-002; `AC-REFUSED-NO-SUCCESSOR` and `AC-POST-FOLD-FAILURES` to T-003; `AC-SUPERSEDE-MATRIX-COMPLETE` to T-004; `AC-LOCK-AND-ALLOCATOR-KEPT` to T-005; `AC-MEMBER-MATRIX-COMPLETE` to T-006. The four close-bound criteria (`AC-NO-UNFORCED-WRITES`, `AC-CLOSE-PAYER`, `AC-CLOSE-LINT`, `AC-CLOSE-TESTS`) are deliberately absent from every `Satisfies`. The full CI-equivalent verification is the single `TargetAssertions` `MustPassCommand` `bun run validate:ci`, run close-time under `--assertions target --run-commands` and `--assertions final --run-commands`, never a per-task command.

T-001.Title: Re-author the close-time scope guard and fix the dormancy defect

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: `src/artifact/scope.test.ts` is re-authored to this bundle's exact id `C-SUPERSEDE-INTEGRATION-CLOSE-1-82073AAC` and base `73044f83c3f4eaaaa5c5b7648a8a31c115337c39`, with an allowed observable set of exactly the twelve literal non-lifecycle paths (zero globs) and identity-exact lifecycle recognition for this bundle only. The committed B5 defect is fixed: the unconditional mint-time foreign-bundle assertion that runs with no switch and fails on a future sibling bundle is removed or restricted, so the guard is **dormant** without its exact switch — it collects no evidence, computes no offenders, and does not inspect or fail on a sibling bundle. **Activated**, it recognizes only this bundle's own lifecycle files and rejects a newly changed foreign sibling path, a planted forbidden ordinary path, a non-record file inside the record directory, and a non-lifecycle file inside its own bundle directory; `decisions.md` is excluded; no blanket sibling exemption exists.

Availability and parsed path lines come from one checked git invocation, and a disagreement between a first successful read and a second failing read must not report a false clean; unavailable git evidence refuses rather than reporting clean.

`src/grace-supersede.test.ts` drives `AC-SUCCESS-PATH-PRESERVED` end to end on real-`.git` disposable projects: a supersede of a predecessor with an unterminated open epoch retains the successor lineage, the predecessor `status="superseded"` with a `<Replacement>` child, exactly one new ledger epoch with exactly one `discarded` and no engine-authored `terminal`, deleted loose files with `run/` surviving empty, the predecessor archived, each ledger event matching its loose event under `expectedLedgerEventAttributes` plus its complete child subtrees, `src/example.ts` byte-identical, stdout exactly the archive-relative path, and `supersedeChainDepth` incrementing on the replacement only. The integrated version additionally drives an explicit `--replacement` successor and a spec-only predecessor (no `plan.xml`, no `run/`) with exit 0 and no invented `plan.xml`.

`src/grace-supersede.test.ts` and `src/gates/core.test.ts` assemble the complete refusal matrix for both implicit and explicit `--replacement` forms: every refusal class leaves `.ngrace/changes/active/` with no directory the invocation created, except a handled-cleanup refusal that leaves exactly one named residual directory and its reason. Recursive union-key path/type/symlink/file-byte snapshots prove the post-refusal tree, a cleaned fixture repeated with the same resolved id leaves the active-set count and names unchanged, a retained-residue fixture leaves exactly one named invocation-created directory, and a same-id repeat adds none. Post-fold failures are driven as real fixtures: a post-fold governance-status write failure, a rename/`EXDEV` failure, and a cleanup failure, each naming the direct exit, the exact allowed snapshot difference, and the fold evidence that legitimately remains, with rollback composed per the failure taxonomy.

The complete supersede matrix (item 11) is driven on disposable real-`.git` projects with recursive union-key snapshots: live and stale predecessor and successor; replacement existence and location races under the fired under-lock seam; branch/timestamp drift proving the locked successor id equals the minted leaf id; explicit replacement never cleaned; governance-write and rename/`EXDEV` rollback failures; cleanup-removal failure; and the five-step success chain. The explicit-replacement rows are revalidated under the sorted candidate locks before any fold or write. For implicit-mint drift, change the branch/timestamp environment at the existing under-lock test seam after id resolution but before mint; assert the held successor lock and minted leaf both name the pre-resolved id.
